name: How does AKN Design Group ensure quality and craftsmanship in custom home construction?

mainEntity.name: How does AKN Design Group ensure quality and craftsmanship in custom home construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: AKN Design Group ensures exceptional quality and craftsmanship in custom home construction through our integrated design-build process and unwavering commitment to core values. With over two decades of experience and more than 10,000 jobs completed, our proven track record speaks to our dedication. We utilize skilled tradespeople and meticulous oversight from design planning through installation. Anthony Nusbaumer's leadership emphasizes honesty, reliability, and craftsmanship, building trust and lasting impressions. Our focus on a high-touch homeowner experience includes clear communication and rigorous quality checks at every stage, delivering a superior custom home.
acceptedAnswer.description: We ensure quality through our integrated design-build process, skilled craftsmanship, meticulous oversight, and over two decades of experience, prioritizing honesty, reliability, and clear communication.
